title: Missing moeb tool: Read — no moeb equivalent for bypassing read_file cache-hit without inline content
description: Used the native Claude Code Read tool as a workaround in run c6af8022-8df4-4edf-8bb0-97b1a8dda8b8 when mcp__moeb__read_file returned cache-hit responses without inline file content. No moeb tool exists that unconditionally returns full file content bypassing the session cache. This directly causes moeb-tool-origin rubric failures whenever read_file cache-hit behavior is triggered after context compaction.
proposed_resolution: Fixing the root cause (signal a1000070-0606-4000-8000-000000000070: read_file cache-hit should include inline content) would eliminate the need for this tool. If a bypass tool is still needed, consider adding a read_file_uncached variant or a force_read boolean parameter to read_file.
